items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: I was learning how to play when I was playing with Jay.

ctx.x: Can there be help with anything in particular? Yes, just learning how to play. No, I was learning how to play when I was playing with Jay.

I was still learning how to play. I had been playing a long time. But Jaylee, he would play some things, and I would listen to it, and try to get under what he was playing. You could play like that when you know it would make you feel that he wanted that piano to come out. So Natalie, if you had any feeling at all, you'd get under that piano. She would still carry that time, you know.
